column3: unbroken Om pleasing to the heart
salutation I make with heart, speech, body
body thrilled, forgetting the world's confusion
being a cause also in the unreal
even those who think cause, purpose, action
with aloe-scented smoke issuing from golden windows
scented with golden lotus and utpala pollen
devoid of to-be-abandoned and to-be-taken, mounted
terrified by neighing, the wink-less abandon
in the slaying of Haihaya Arjuna
of the non-doer, though accepted, uncovered
this from the mouth of fire
the unborn and others as non-Self
ignorant of you, thinking themselves lords apart
beyond creation and over the world
this one with unseen end, unseen supreme
of the Endless, of the imperishable Self
because not to be known by another
those who have not turned back, body-abandoners
one who has not fulfilled his promise
of the one who is a part of the sun
worthy, best water, grass, ground, lords and lesser
to the dweller of Avanti city
part of the Self of all beings
even the wicked are doers of purpose
those who are angry at the serpents
other than the Self, other from other
the Self by the Self itself from inauspicious intent
was of the hard to see
of you, to whom the single-minded devotee
this, rare even for the single-minded
by the speed of the flood
devoid of modesty, fortune, compassion, fame
